name: Internet Tasmania (Intas)
summary: Tasmanian ISP: Internet Tasmania (Intas, c.1996) and BBW Telecom (c.2001) were both trading names of Broadband Wireless Pty Ltd (ACN 096 428 634, Hobart); took over all TrumpNet customers Aug 2007; creditors' voluntary liquidation 11 Apr 2012; customer base absorbed by iiNet (per user report; no public announcement).

events.details: Operated as a Hobart/Launceston ISP; sister brand BBW Telecom of Broadband Wireless Pty Ltd from c.2001 (earliest bbw.net.au capture 20 Sep 2003).

Broadband Wireless Pty Ltd (ACN 096 428 634), formerly trading as BBW Telecom & Internet Tasmania, entered creditors' voluntary liquidation 11 Apr 2012 (ASIC published notices); customer base absorbed by iiNet ~Feb 2012 (per user report; no public announcement). bbw.net.au homepage froze at 2011 content and lingered as a static page to ~2021.
